scope: macOS client reads native Windows Downloads TAK files over SSH; experimental transport only, not a native Windows viewer run or app integration

selection.method: Smallest, median-ranked, largest by byte size; source paths and participant names omitted
selection.representativeness: Three size-ranked samples do not validate all89 files or all TAK layouts

method: Five methods times three rounds per file,45 timed runs total. Rotated order, cold logical client cache per mode, server filesystem cache not flushed, no simultaneous bandwidth tests.
timing: Cumulative stages include discovery, server work in server_index modes, transfer and payload reconstruction. Connection setup separately reported; viewer decode/render excluded.
received_byte_metric: Source range bytes plus indexJSON; excludes outgoing requests, OK delimiters and SSH framing.
windows_transport: Short cmd-compatible bootstrap; helper source and Unicode path delivered as first ASCII JSON stdin line; binary stdin/stdout and LF text replies; existing range/index/MD5 protocol retained. No helper file created on server.
preview: Actual frame IDs [0,120). Independent metadata checks show StartFrame0 and100Hz for all3 files: first1.2seconds, with sparse/late channels handled.

validation.actual_windows_smoke: Unicode/spaced source path opened and exact compound magic fetched
validation.integrity: All45 mode runs passed range/staged MD5 checks; each sampled file whole-source MD5 matched. Staged hashes additionally matched independent existing TakContainer and complete linear frame scan executed in Windows memory.
validation.protocol_tests: Long helper, Unicode/metacharacter paths via stdin, queued index/range/MD5 framing, CR/LF/Ctrl-Z bytes, unchanged Linux default command, source mutation rejection

observations: Server-side index discovery avoids sequential client round trips on Windows too.
Largest11.8MBsample has1196nonanalog+28analog records; client marker-first uses1230 requests and takes11.22s median to first data. Server marker-first uses8 requests and takes0.456s.
For largest sample, early preview0.552s is slower than full nonanalog-first0.456s; fewer received bytes alone do not guarantee earlier readiness.

Selected-all completes sooner than staged variants for these samples. Server-index staged variants offer earlier partial availability at the cost of later completion; client-index variants do not beat selected-all readiness.
File size alone cannot choose an optimal strategy. These samples differ from earlier Linux samples, so these results do not isolate operating-system performance.

cpu_diagnostic.purpose: Diagnostic CPU profiling with memory-backed transport and local index emulation; excludes real SSH and must not be used as network latency measurement
